entries.Original: If you run into any issues please submit feedback via the plugin installer feedback button.
entries.Translated: 如果遇到任何问题，请通过插件安装器的反馈按钮提交反馈。

entries.Original: This plugin is written in some of the free time that I have. It's a labour of love and I will hopefully be actively releasing updates for a while.
entries.Translated: 本插件是利用我的一些空闲时间编写的。它倾注了我的心血，希望我能在一段时间内持续发布更新。

entries.Original: If a item can be acquired(mounts, minions, etc) this shows whether or not it has been acquired on the currently logged in character.
entries.Translated: 如果物品可以获取（坐骑、宠物等），则显示当前登录角色是否已获取。

entries.Original: Has this item be acquired by your active character?
entries.Translated: 该物品是否已被当前角色获得？

entries.Original: See the log pane below for a chronological list of acquisition events.
entries.Translated: 请查看下方日志面板以获取按时间顺序排列的获取事件列表。

entries.Original: Search for a source in a specific map.
entries.Translated: 搜索特定地图中的来源。

entries.Original: Search for a source that requires a specific item.
entries.Translated: 搜索需要特定物品的来源。

entries.Original: Search for a source that rewards a specific item. While this might seem redundant, certain sources provide more than one item.
entries.Translated: 搜索奖励特定物品的来源。虽然这看起来有些多余，但某些来源会提供多个物品。

entries.Original: Shows icons indicating what items can be obtained with(gathering, crafting, currency, etc)
entries.Translated: 显示图标，指示物品可以通过何种方式获得（群狼大厅、制作、货币等）

entries.Original: The acquisition tracker perform an initial scan of your characters bags when you login. As the game receives multiple inventory updates, the scanner must wait a set amount of time before it's done. Adjust this to be higher if you are seeing items in your craft list randomly complete when you first login.
entries.Translated: 获取追踪器会在登录时对角色背包进行初始扫描。由于游戏会收到多次背包更新，扫描器必须等待一段时间才能完成。如果你在首次登录时发现制作列表中的物品随机完成，请调高此值。

entries.Original: The acquisition tracker will track your current state(crafting, gathering, etc). It will keep this state by default for 2 seconds after it changes back to doing nothing. This is to catch any delays in the tracker, set this number higher if you find the tracker is not picking up items you craft/gather/etc
entries.Translated: 获取追踪器会追踪你的当前状态（制作、采集等）。当状态变回空闲后，默认会保持该状态 2 秒。这是为了捕捉追踪器中的延迟，如果你发现追踪器没有记录你制作/采集等的物品，请调高此数值。

entries.Original: This is the craft list that crafts will count towards.
entries.Translated: 这是制作将计入的制作列表。

entries.Original: Adds a button to the title menu along side the dalamud menu items allowing you to open Allagan Tools while not logged in.
entries.Translated: 在标题菜单中 Dalamud 菜单项旁添加一个按钮，让你在未登录时也能打开 Allagan Tools。
的飞空艇探索点未找到。

entries.Original: Airship Exploration Point with the ID
An bonus attributes of the item(Strength, HP, Perception, etc)
entries.Translated: 物品的附加属性（力量、HP、感知等）

entries.Original: The attribute to show in the column

Should the inventories/configuration be automatically saved on a defined interval? While the plugin does save when the game is closed and when configurations are altered, it is not saved in cases of crashing so this attempts to alleviate this.
entries.Translated: 背包/配置是否应按设定的时间间隔自动保存？虽然插件在游戏关闭和配置更改时会保存，但崩溃时不会保存，因此此选项尝试缓解此问题。

entries.Original: How many minutes should there be between each auto save?
entries.Translated: 每次自动保存之间应间隔多少分钟？

entries.Original: Should price data be automatically downloaded when it's viewed in a list?
entries.Translated: 在列表中查看价格数据时，是否自动下载？

entries.Original: This is the list that is currently being highlighted when the allagan tools window is not visible. This list can be toggled with the associated slash commands.
entries.Translated: 这是当 Allagan Tools 窗口不可见时当前高亮的列表。此列表可通过相关斜杠命令切换。

entries.Original: These settings apply to the whole plugin. You can change all of them later in the settings window.
entries.Translated: 这些设置适用于整个插件。之后你可以在设置窗口中更改所有设置。

entries.Original: Allied Societies the player can gain reputation with.
entries.Translated: 玩家可提升声望的友好部族。

entries.Original: Shows the relative item level of either your items or your retainers items compared to the item shown. This will show a drop down in the filter that lets you pick which character you are comparing against. A negative value indicates it's worse, a positive indicates it's better.
entries.Translated: 显示你的物品或雇员物品相对于所显示物品的相对物品等级。这会在筛选器中显示一个下拉菜单，让你选择要对比的角色。负值表示更差，正值表示更好。

entries.Original: How much the item can be purchased from a vendor(gil)
entries.Translated: 可从商人处购买的金额（金币）

entries.Original: The price when bought from shops.
Can the item be high quality?
entries.Translated: 该物品可以是高品质吗？

entries.Original: Can the item be placed on the marketboard?
entries.Translated: 该物品可上架市场板吗？

entries.Original: Can this item be placed on the market?
entries.Translated: 该物品可以上架市场吗？

entries.Original: Can the item be purchased with gil?
entries.Translated: 该物品可用金币购买吗？

entries.Original: Display's the name of the owner of the character this item is on if applicable(retainers, free companies, etc)
entries.Translated: 显示该物品所在角色的所有者名称（如适用）（雇员、部队等）

entries.Original: Edit name, set the name to blank to return it to the original name.
entries.Translated: 编辑名称，将名称留空可恢复为原始名称。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to clear the inventories of this
Are you sure you want to delete this
The following characters will be searched in:
entries.Translated: 将在以下范围内搜索角色：

entries.Original: By default, every character Allagan Tools knows about is searched.
entries.Translated: 默认情况下，会搜索 Allagan Tools 已知的所有角色。

entries.Original: By providing a set of scopes, you are narrowing down from which characters are displayed/counted.
entries.Translated: 通过提供一组范围，你可以缩小显示/统计的角色范围。

entries.Original: Match against a specific character(player character, retainer, free company, etc)
entries.Translated: 匹配特定角色（玩家角色、雇员、部队等）

entries.Original: Match against the currently logged in character.
No scopes defined yet. Press add to start.
entries.Translated: 尚未定义范围。按添加开始。

entries.Original: The character scope editor allows you define which characters you want to search across.
entries.Translated: 角色范围编辑器允许你定义要搜索哪些角色。

entries.Original: When 'All' or 'World' is selected, choose the types of characters you want to filter against. Select an item again to unselect it.
entries.Translated: 当选择“全部”或“服务器”时，选择要筛选的角色类型。再次选择某项可取消选择。

entries.Original: When checked, match against the opposite of what is selected.
entries.Translated: 勾选后，匹配与所选相反的内容。

entries.Original: Select the characters you want to search inside.
This will clear the locked colour and all progress.
entries.Translated: 这将清除锁定的颜色和所有进度。

entries.Original: No companion summoned (colour = 0 defaults to Desert Yellow).
entries.Translated: 未召唤搭档（颜色 = 0 默认为沙漠黄）。

entries.Original: Chocobo colour data provided by Lulu.
entries.Translated: 陆行鸟颜色数据由 Lulu 提供。

entries.Original: Feed before recolouring to start fresh.
entries.Translated: 重新染色前先喂食以重新开始。

entries.Original: Feed to your chocobo to reset its colour
entries.Translated: 喂给陆行鸟以将其颜色重置

entries.Original: Resets chocobo colour to Desert Yellow.
entries.Translated: 将陆行鸟颜色重置为沙漠黄。

entries.Original: so you can begin recolouring again.
entries.Translated: 这样你就可以重新开始染色了。

entries.Original: Check off each fruit as you feed it to your chocobo.
entries.Translated: 每喂给陆行鸟一个果实时勾选一次。

entries.Original: Lock in this sequence to track feeding progress.
entries.Translated: 锁定此顺序以追踪喂食进度。

entries.Original: No path found between these two colours. They may be one of the rare pairs that cannot be reached from one another by feeding fruits.
entries.Translated: 在这两种颜色之间未找到引导步廊。它们可能是无法通过喂果实互相到达的稀有组合之一。

entries.Original: Select a target colour to generate the fruit sequence.
entries.Translated: 选择目标颜色以生成果实序列。

entries.Original:
The fruit sequence is an estimate based on RGB colour math.
Due to in-game rounding, the result may occasionally differ
by a fruit or two, if you don't land on the target colour,
feed a Han Lemon to reset to Desert Yellow and try again.
entries.Translated:
果实顺序是基于 RGB 颜色数学的估算。
由于游戏内取整，结果偶尔可能相差
一两个果实，如果没有达到目标颜色，
喂一个汉柠檬重置为沙漠黄后重试。

entries.Original: All fruits fed! Check your chocobo's colour.
entries.Translated: 所有果实已喂完！检查你的陆行鸟颜色。

entries.Original: Clear the locked sequence and reset all feeding progress.
entries.Translated: 清除已锁定的顺序并重置所有喂食进度。

entries.Original: Items consumed or equipped by chocobo companions.
entries.Translated: 陆行鸟搭档消耗或装备的物品。

entries.Original: The classes/jobs your character can learn.
entries.Translated: 你的角色可以学习的职业/特职。

entries.Original: The alpha is currently set to 0, this will be invisible.
entries.Translated: 当前透明度为 0，将不可见。

entries.Original: Should the name of the retainer in the summoning bell list be coloured if a relevant item is to be sorted or is available in their inventory?
entries.Translated: 如果传唤铃列表中的雇员有相关物品需要整理或库存中有该物品，是否为其名称着色？

entries.Original: Add a new column. Leave the column name blank if you want to use the default.
entries.Translated: 添加新列。如果想使用默认名称，请将列名留空。

entries.Original: No entries found for this territory.
entries.Translated: 此区域内未找到任何条目。

entries.Original: What should the minimum height of rows show in compendium lists be?
entries.Translated: 图鉴列表中行的最小高度应显示为多少？

entries.Original: No item could be found with the ID
entries.Translated: 未找到该 ID 的物品

entries.Original: Should the compendium windows be listed in wotsit's search?
entries.Translated: 图鉴窗口是否应列在 wotsit 的搜索中？

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to remove this filter?
entries.Translated: 确定要移除此过滤器吗？

entries.Original: This will create a list that lets you search for all items in the game.
entries.Translated: 这将创建一个列表，让你可以搜索游戏中的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will create a list that lets you view historical data of how your inventory has changed.
entries.Translated: 这将创建一个列表，让你可以查看背包变化的历史数据。

entries.Original: This will create a new list that let's you search for specific items within your characters and retainers inventories then determine where they should be moved to.
entries.Translated: 这将创建一个新列表，让你可以在角色和雇员背包中搜索特定物品，然后确定它们应该被移动到何处。

entries.Original: This will create a new list that let's you search for specific items within your characters and retainers inventories.
entries.Translated: 这将创建一个新列表，让你可以在角色和雇员背包中搜索特定物品。

entries.Original: Show this wizard when new features are released
entries.Translated: 发布新功能时显示此向导

entries.Original: If you are a returning user, feel free to close this window.
entries.Translated: 如果你是老用户，可以直接关闭此窗口。

entries.Original: There are new features available to configure and you elected to show this window when that occurs.
entries.Translated: 有可配置的新功能，你已选择在出现时显示此窗口。

entries.Original: This will guide you through what the plugin does and then help you set up the most commonly used features. It takes a couple of minutes, and everything here can be changed later in the settings window.
entries.Translated: 这将引导你了解该插件的功能，然后帮助你设置最常用的功能。只需几分钟，这里的所有内容之后都可以在设置窗口中更改。

entries.Original: Welcome back to the Allagan Tools configuration wizard.
entries.Translated: 欢迎回到 Allagan Tools 配置向导。

entries.Original: Welcome to the Allagan Tools configuration wizard.
entries.Translated: 欢迎使用 Allagan Tools 配置向导。

entries.Original: You can also go back through the introduction covering what the plugin does.
entries.Translated: 你也可以返回查看介绍，了解该插件的功能。

entries.Original: Add a submenu to add the item to a active craft list?
entries.Translated: 添加一个子菜单以将物品添加到当前制作列表？

entries.Original: Add a submenu to add the item to a craft list?
entries.Translated: 添加一个子菜单以将物品添加到制作列表？

entries.Original: Add a submenu to add the item to a curated list?
entries.Translated: 添加一个子菜单以将物品添加到精选列表？

entries.Original: Add a submenu to add/remove the item to/from your favourites?
entries.Translated: 添加一个子菜单以将物品添加/移除收藏？

entries.Original: Copies the item's name to the clipboard.
entries.Translated: 将物品名称复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: The plugin can add these entries to item's right-click menus.
entries.Translated: 插件可以将这些条目添加到物品的右键菜单中。

entries.Original: When searching for an item across the inventories AT knows about, which inventories should be searched?
entries.Translated: 在 AT 已知的库存中搜索物品时，应搜索哪些库存？

entries.Original: Performs a search covering either all inventories or the scope defined below?
entries.Translated: 执行覆盖所有背包或下方定义范围的搜索？

entries.Original: Entries Allagan Tools adds to the game's own right-click menus. Each one costs a line in menus you already use, so they are individually switchable.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 添加到游戏自带右键菜单的条目。每个条目都会占用你已在使用菜单中的一行，因此可以单独开关。

entries.Original: If you want to limit the locations it searches, configure the search scope below.
entries.Translated: 如果你想限制搜索位置，请在下方配置搜索范围。

entries.Original: Opens the Allagan Tools information window for whatever was right-clicked.
entries.Translated: 为右键点击的内容打开 Allagan Tools 信息窗口。

entries.Original: Shortcuts to open the various logs within the game.
entries.Translated: 打开游戏内各种日志的快捷方式。

entries.Original: The search locations also apply to searches started from Allagan Tools' own menus, not just this context menu entry.
entries.Translated: 搜索位置同样适用于从 Allagan Tools 自身菜单发起的搜索，而不仅仅是此右键菜单条目。

entries.Original: This search is more expansive than the game's default search functionality as it searches across every character the plugin knows about.
entries.Translated: 此搜索比游戏默认搜索功能更广泛，因为它会搜索插件已知的所有角色。

entries.Original: Add the more information menu item to the right click/context menu for monsters?
entries.Translated: 为怪物添加更多信息菜单项到右键/上下文菜单？

entries.Original: Add the more information menu item to the right click/context menu for npcs?
entries.Translated: 为 NPC 添加更多信息菜单项到右键/上下文菜单？

entries.Original: Add the more information menu item to the right click/context menu for items?
entries.Translated: 为物品添加更多信息菜单项到右键/上下文菜单？

entries.Original: Add a context menu item to open the crafting log for any item that can be crafted?
entries.Translated: 添加上下文菜单项以打开任何可制作物品的制作笔记？

entries.Original: Add a context menu item to open the fishing log for any item that can be fished?
entries.Translated: 添加上下文菜单项以打开任何可钓鱼物品的钓鱼笔记？

entries.Original: Add a context menu item to open the gathering log for any item that can be gathered?
entries.Translated: 添加上下文菜单项以打开任何可采集物品的采集笔记？

entries.Original: Copies the item name to the clipboard.
entries.Translated: 将物品名称复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: This is the amount to retrieve from retainers.
entries.Translated: 这是要从雇员处取回的数量。

entries.Original: This is the amount that you could craft given the items in your inventory
entries.Translated: 这是根据你库存中的物品可以制作的数量

entries.Original: This is the amount available within your filtered inventories available to complete the craft.
entries.Translated: 这是在你已筛选的库存中可用于完成制作的数量。

entries.Original: The amount required with inventory and external sources factored in/The amount required without inventory and external sources factored in.
entries.Translated: 计入背包和外部来源后的所需数量/不计入背包和外部来源的所需数量。

entries.Original: This is the amount that needs to be sourced from MB/gathering excluding potential items to be withdrawn from retainers.
entries.Translated: 这是需要从市场板/群狼大厅获取的数量，不包括可能从雇员处取回的物品。

entries.Original: A button that opens the crafting log for the item
entries.Translated: 打开该物品制作笔记的按钮

entries.Original: A button/list to show you where you can buy an item
entries.Translated: 显示物品购买地点的按钮/列表

entries.Original: This will calculate the total amount of an item that could be crafted based on the items within your character and retainers. You can override which inventories are looked in by selecting a custom scope below.
entries.Translated: 这将根据你角色和雇员中的物品计算可制作物品的总数量。你可以通过选择下方的自定义范围来覆盖要查看的库存。

entries.Original: Please make sure you include at least one inventory that contains crystals otherwise the craft calculator will not work. If no scopes are picked, the craft calculator will look in your active characters inventories and their retainers.
entries.Translated: 请确保至少包含一个含有水晶的库存，否则制作计算器将无法工作。如果未选择任何范围，制作计算器将查看你当前角色的库存及其雇员。

entries.Original: When an output reaches 0, should it be deleted or just be hidden(when Hide Completed is checked).
entries.Translated: 当产出达到 0 时，应删除还是仅隐藏（勾选隐藏已完成时）。

entries.Original: Should the crystals be grouped together or show up in the Gather/Buy list?
entries.Translated: 水晶应分组显示还是显示在采集/购买列表中？

entries.Original: Should the currency be grouped together or show up in the Gather/Buy list?
entries.Translated: 货币应分组显示还是显示在采集/购买列表中？

entries.Original: Should each item in the list require a HQ version of the item(if applicable)?
entries.Translated: 列表中的每个物品是否都需要高品质版本（如适用）？

entries.Original: What should the default 'Retrieve from Retainer' setting be for 'Non-output' items?
entries.Translated: 对于“非产出”物品，“从雇员取回”的默认设置应为什么？

entries.Original: What should the default 'Retrieve from Retainer' setting be for 'Output' items?
entries.Translated: 对于“产出”物品，“从雇员取回”的默认设置应为什么？

entries.Original: Which inventories should the crafting list attempt to sort the items found in 'Inventories to Retrieve From' to?
entries.Translated: 制作列表应尝试将“取回来源库存”中找到的物品排序到哪些库存？

entries.Original: Should the craft items be placed in a single table or grouped into multiple tabs.
entries.Translated: 制作物品应放在单个表格中还是分组到多个标签页中。

entries.Original: How should everything else not in it's own group be grouped?
entries.Translated: 其他不属于各自分组的内容应如何分组？

entries.Original: Shows a button that links to gatherbuddy's /gather function.
entries.Translated: 显示一个链接到 gatherbuddy 的 /gather 功能的按钮。

entries.Original: The colour of the header text in the craft list.
entries.Translated: 制作列表中标题文字的颜色。

entries.Original: How should house vendor items be grouped?
entries.Translated: 房屋商人物品应如何分组？

entries.Original: When generating the materials for a craft, the 'Ingredient Sourcing' setting determines the preferred method of acquisition. The craft list will refer to this sorted list to determine the appropriate method. Please note that this assumes the item in the craft list can be obtained through this method. If not, the next item in the ingredient sourcing list will be considered.
entries.Translated: 生成制作材料时，“材料来源”设置决定首选获取方式。制作列表将参考此排序列表来确定合适的方式。请注意，这假定制作列表中的物品可通过此方式获取。若不能，则考虑材料来源列表中的下一项。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to reset the ingredient sourcing order to default?
entries.Translated: 确定要将材料获取顺序重置为默认吗？
点击并拖动以重新排序

entries.Original: Is this craft list ephemeral? If checked, once all the items in the craft list are deleted, the list will delete itself. This is only checked as each craft is completed.
entries.Translated: 此制作列表是否为临时列表？若勾选，一旦制作列表中的所有物品被删除，该列表将自行删除。仅在每次制作完成时检查。

entries.Original: Override the ingredient source for specific items. Overrides set here take precedence over the list's default ingredient sourcing order.
entries.Translated: 为特定物品覆盖材料来源。此处设置的覆盖优先于列表的默认材料来源顺序。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to clear all per-item overrides?
entries.Translated: 确定要清除所有物品的单独覆盖设置吗？

entries.Original: No items have been added to the list. Add items via the search menu button at the top right of the screen or by right clicking on an item anywhere within the plugin.
entries.Translated: 尚未添加任何物品。可通过屏幕右上角的搜索菜单按钮，或在插件内任意位置右键点击物品来添加。

entries.Original: Should the craft list operate normally or in stocking mode. In normal mode, a quantity is entered and as you craft that number goes down. In stock mode, a quantity is entered and the number goes up based on the items within your characters inventory.
entries.Translated: 制作列表应正常运行还是处于库存模式。正常模式下，输入数量，制作时该数字递减。库存模式下，输入数量，该数字根据角色库存中的物品递增。

entries.Original: The current market pricing for the given item.
entries.Translated: 该物品的当前市场价格。

entries.Original: The market price of this item is cheaper than buying it from a vendor and you prefer vendors over the current ingredient preference.
entries.Translated: 该物品的市场价格比从商人处购买更便宜，且你更倾向于商人而非当前的素材偏好。

entries.Original: Instead of reporting every acquisition, only print a message when an item reaches its required quantity. The craft list must be active for notifications to occur.
entries.Translated: 不再报告每次获取，仅在物品达到所需数量时输出消息。通知需要激活制作列表。

entries.Original: The plugin can tell you about your progress as you collect the items for a craft list. These notifications occur only while a craft list is active.
entries.Translated: 当你为制作列表收集物品时，插件可以告知你的进度。这些通知仅在制作列表激活时出现。

entries.Original: When you complete the wizard, the plugin applies these settings to your craft lists and to the default craft list. Each list then keeps its own copy, which you can change in the settings for that list.
entries.Translated: 完成向导后，插件会将这些设置应用到你的制作列表和默认制作列表。每个列表随后会保留自己的副本，你可以在该列表的设置中更改。

entries.Original: Play a sound effect when an item in a craft list reaches its required quantity. The craft list must be active for notifications to occur.
entries.Translated: 当制作列表中的物品达到所需数量时播放音效。通知需要激活制作列表。

entries.Original: When acquiring items that are part of a craft list, print progress to chat. The craft list must be active for notifications to occur.
entries.Translated: 获取制作列表中的物品时，将进度输出到聊天栏。通知需要激活制作列表。

entries.Original: Should the list of output items be ordered in a specific way?
entries.Translated: 产出物品列表是否应按特定方式排序？

entries.Original: Should the craft overlay be hidden during duties/cutscenes/chocobo racing/etc?
entries.Translated: 在任务/过场动画/陆行鸟竞赛等期间是否应隐藏制作悬浮窗？

entries.Original: A compact panel that follows your active craft list while you are in the game, so you can see what is still needed without opening a window.
entries.Translated: 一个紧凑面板，在游戏开始中跟随你的当前制作列表，让你无需打开窗口即可查看还需要什么。

entries.Original: When the craft overlay is expanded, how many items should be shown?
entries.Translated: 制作悬浮窗展开时，应显示多少物品？

entries.Original: Should the craft overlay stay open between plugin reloads/game reloads?
entries.Translated: 插件重载/游戏重载之间制作悬浮窗是否保持打开？

entries.Original: Open the Allagan Tools configuration window.
entries.Translated: 打开 Allagan Tools 配置窗口。

entries.Original: Open the Allagan Tools crafts window.
entries.Translated: 打开 Allagan Tools 制作窗口。

entries.Original: The current state of the craft overlay window.
entries.Translated: 制作悬浮窗的当前状态。

entries.Original: How should precrafts be grouped together?
entries.Translated: 预制作物品应如何分组？

entries.Original: Instead of reporting every acquisition, only print a message when an item reaches its required quantity.
entries.Translated: 不报告每次获取，仅在物品达到所需数量时输出消息。

entries.Original: Play a sound effect when an item in this list reaches its required quantity.
entries.Translated: 当此列表中的物品达到所需数量时播放音效。

entries.Original: Play a sound when an item is complete?
What to prefix each acquisition progress message with. 'Plugin Name' uses [AT], 'Craft List Name' uses the name of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 每条获取进度消息的前缀。“插件名称”使用 [AT]，“制作列表名称”使用此制作列表的名称。
是否在聊天中报告获取进度？

entries.Original: When acquiring items that are part of this craft list, print progress (e.g. "Ironwood Log 30 remaining") to chat. The craft list must be active.
entries.Translated: 当获得属于此制作清单的物品时，将进度（例如“铁木原木 剩余30”）输出到聊天框。制作清单必须处于激活状态。

entries.Original: Which sound effect to play when an item in this list reaches its required quantity (when 'Play a sound when an item is complete?' is enabled).
entries.Translated: 当此清单中的物品达到所需数量时播放哪个音效（当“物品完成时播放音效？”启用时）。

entries.Original: Report progress when an item that is part of this craft list drops from combat.
entries.Translated: 当属于此制作清单的物品从战斗中掉落时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you craft an item that is part of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 当你制作属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you gather an item that is part of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 当你采集属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you buy an item that is part of this craft list from the market board.
entries.Translated: 当你从市场布告板购买属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when an item that is part of this craft list is acquired through any other means.
entries.Translated: 当属于此制作清单的物品通过任何其他方式获得时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you buy an item that is part of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 当你购买属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Should the items you need to retrieve be grouped?
entries.Translated: 你需要取回的物品是否应分组？

entries.Original: Should the craft list be displayed in reverse order? i.e. Should outputs start at the bottom? (This is only applicable when the Craft Display Mode is single table)
entries.Translated: 制作列表是否按倒序显示？即输出是否从底部开始？（仅在制作显示模式为单表时适用）

entries.Original: Modify each items craft settings in this column
entries.Translated: 在此列中修改各物品的制作设置

entries.Original: Should the item be HQ or NQ? For output items, the quantity needed will only reduce if you craft an item of the correct quality. For other materials this will dictate what is listed to retrieve and what counts towards the amount you need.
entries.Translated: 该物品应为 HQ 还是 NQ？对于产出物品，只有制作出正确品质的物品才会减少所需数量。对于其他材料，这将决定列出要取回的内容以及计入所需数量的内容。

entries.Original: Override the price for this item. This is only used when no pricing is available. Use this to give you a rough estimate of the gil cost of your item.
entries.Translated: 覆盖此物品的价格。仅在无可用价格时使用。用于粗略估算该物品的金币成本。

entries.Original: Override the market world preferences for this item. If you select a world here, the craft pricer will attempt to take prices from this world first then follow the normal rules for craft pricing.
entries.Translated: 覆盖此物品的市场服务器偏好。若在此选择服务器，制作定价器会优先尝试从该服务器获取价格，然后遵循正常的制作定价规则。

entries.Original: Select which recipe you wish to use for this item. Some items can be crafted by multiple classes.
entries.Translated: 选择你希望用于此物品的配方。某些物品可由多个职业制作。

entries.Original: Should we source the item from your retainers? If there is a quantity available of the correct quality it will show up in the Items in Retainers/Bags section.
entries.Translated: 是否从你的雇员处获取该物品？若有正确品质的可用数量，将显示在雇员/背包中的物品部分。

entries.Original: How should the item be sourced? As there are multiple ways to source an item, you can either rely on your list's ingredient sourcing (tab inside the craft list's settings) or you can override the source here.
entries.Translated: 该物品应如何获取？由于物品有多种获取途径，你可以依赖列表的素材获取设置（制作列表设置中的标签页），也可以在此处覆盖获取途径。

entries.Original: Where should the item be sourced from? As there are sometimes multiple locations to source an item from, you can either rely on your list's zone preferences (tab inside the craft list's settings) or you can override the zone here.
entries.Translated: 该物品应从何处获取？由于有时物品有多个获取地点，你可以依赖列表的区域偏好（制作列表设置中的标签页），也可以在此处覆盖区域。

entries.Original: Shows a simplified version of what you should do next in your craft
entries.Translated: 显示你在制作中下一步应该做什么的简化版本

entries.Original: Crystals allow specialization in a crafting class.
entries.Translated: 水晶可让制作职业专精化。

entries.Original: Which inventories should the crafting list check for materials to withdraw? Items found in the selected inventories will appear in the 'Items in Retainers/Bags' list and you will need to retrieve them either before gathering or after gathering depending on your craft list's configuration.
entries.Translated: 制作清单应检查哪些物品栏以获取吸引的材料？在所选物品栏中找到的物品将出现在“雇员/背包中的物品”列表中，你需要根据制作清单的配置在采集前或采集后取回它们。

entries.Original: When crafting, what inventories should be considered the staging area? Any items in the staging area are considered in the users inventories. By default the current character's bags, crystals and currency are the staging area but if you wanted to include the saddlebag you could.
entries.Translated: 制作时，哪些物品栏应被视为模仿细胞？模仿细胞中的任何物品都被视为用户物品栏中的物品。默认情况下，当前角色的背包、水晶和货币为模仿细胞，但如果你想包含鞍囊也可以。

entries.Original: When you are in combat and an item drops and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当你在战斗中且物品掉落并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When a craft is completed and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that craft item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当完成一次制作并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该制作物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When gathering is performed and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当进行采集并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When you buy something off the market board and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当你从市场布告板购买某物并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When any other event causes you to gain an item and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当任何其他事件使你获得物品并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When an item is purchased from a shop and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当从商店购买物品并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: Set the layout of the craft window
What view is the craft list currently in?
entries.Translated: 制作列表当前处于哪个视图？

entries.Original: Which worlds should prices be sourced from?
entries.Translated: 价格应从哪些服务器获取？

entries.Original: Should your currently logged in character's active world be used as a pricing source?
entries.Translated: 是否将当前登录角色的所在服务器作为价格来源？

entries.Original: Should the worlds selected in 'Price Worlds' in the main settings be automatically used for pricing?
entries.Translated: 是否应自动使用主设置中“价格服务器”所选的服务器进行定价？

entries.Original: Should your currently logged in character's home world be used as a pricing source?
entries.Translated: 是否将当前登录角色的主服务器作为价格来源？

entries.Original: The zone in which this item should be gathered from. This is only relevant to craft lists.
entries.Translated: 该物品应从哪个区域采集。这仅与制作列表相关。

entries.Original: (such as the FC Workshop or your Grand Company supply list).
entries.Translated: （例如部队工房或大国防联军补给列表）。

entries.Original: Each option adds its items to the currently selected craft list.
entries.Translated: 每个选项都会将其物品添加到当前选中的制作列表。

entries.Original: This menu appears because Allagan Tools detected a supported game window open
entries.Translated: 此菜单出现是因为 Allagan Tools 检测到支持的游戏窗口已打开

entries.Original: . This likely means Universalis is having issues. Allagan Tools will back off requests for 30 seconds whenever this happens.
entries.Translated: 。这很可能意味着 Universalis 出现了问题。每当发生这种情况，Allagan Tools 将暂停请求 30 秒。

entries.Original: Hide any precrafts/gather/buy items once completed?
entries.Translated: 完成后是否隐藏预制作/采集/购买物品？

entries.Original: It appears you are sending too many requests to Universalis, if you have multiple plugins requesting marketboard data, this is the most likely cause.
entries.Translated: 您似乎向 Universalis 发送了过多请求，如果您有多个插件请求市场数据，这很可能是原因。

entries.Original: Open the craft list's tree view.
entries.Translated: 打开制作列表的树状视图。

entries.Original: Shows missing requirements for the current craft list.
entries.Translated: 显示当前制作列表缺少的需求。

entries.Original: There was an error when contacting Universalis at
entries.Translated: 联系 Universalis 时出错，地址为

entries.Original: This button turns red when your craft list contains items that require unlocks you don't have (recipe books, folklore tomes, job levels). Click it to see exactly what you're missing.
entries.Translated: 当你的制作列表包含需要你尚未解锁的内容（配方书、传承录、职业等级）的物品时，此按钮会变红。点击它可查看你具体缺少什么。

entries.Original: This is the craft list that finished crafts will count towards.
entries.Translated: 这是制作列表，完成的制作物品将计入其中。

entries.Original: This is the ephemeral craft list, once all items in it are completed, the list will delete itself.
entries.Translated: 这是临时制作列表，一旦其中所有物品都完成，该列表将自动删除。

entries.Original: Toggles the add item side bar.
When checked, any items you need to retrieve from external sources will be highlighted.
entries.Translated: 勾选后，需要从外部来源获取的物品将被高亮显示。

entries.Original: Get started by adding a craft list by hitting the + button on the bottom left.
entries.Translated: 点击左下角的 + 按钮添加制作列表即可开始。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to clear your craft list?
entries.Translated: 确定要清空制作列表吗？

entries.Original: Compendium is a WIP feature, expect more here soon!
entries.Translated: 图鉴功能仍在开发中，敬请期待更多内容！
制作清单（缺少的可采集物）
刷新所有价格 (制作列表)
刷新所有价格 (雇员/背包)

entries.Original: This will paste the contents of items copied via the 'Copy List Contents' menu above, it also will attempt to parse Teamcraft lists if one is in your clipboard. If you have a garland tools URL in your clipboard that points to a group, it will also attempt to parse that add it to your craft list.
entries.Translated: 这将粘贴通过上方“复制清单内容”菜单复制的物品内容，如果剪贴板中有 Teamcraft 清单，也会尝试解析。如果剪贴板中有指向某个分组的 garland tools 网址，也会尝试解析并将其添加到你的制作清单中。

entries.Original: [CTRL] to open in a new window.

Are you sure you want to reset the default craft list?.
This operation cannot be undone!
entries.Translated:
您确定要重置默认制作列表吗？
此操作无法撤销！
复制现有筛选器的设置

entries.Original: No other configurations available to copy from.
entries.Translated: 没有其他可复制的配置。

entries.Original: Reset craft list to default configuration (keeps items).
entries.Translated: 将制作列表重置为默认配置（保留物品）。

entries.Original: This is the default configuration for new craft lists. Any new craft list will inherit this lists settings.
entries.Translated: 这是新制作列表的默认配置。任何新制作列表都将继承此列表的设置。

entries.Original: You are currently editing default craft list configuration.
entries.Translated: 您当前正在编辑默认制作列表配置。

entries.Original: You are currently editing the craft list's configuration. Press the tick on the right hand side to save configuration.
entries.Translated: 您当前正在编辑制作列表的配置。按右侧的对勾保存配置。

entries.Original: Add a new ephemeral craft list that will be deleted once all the items in it are completed.
entries.Translated: 添加新的临时制作列表，当其中所有物品完成后将被删除。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to remove this craft list?
entries.Translated: 确定要移除该制作清单吗？

entries.Original: A custom button letting you specify a custom command you wish to run with the item's name or ID
entries.Translated: 自定义按钮，可指定一个使用物品名称或 ID 运行的自定义命令

entries.Original: The command to run. A slash will automatically be added for you. You can add the ***Name*** to output the name of the item or ***ID*** to output the name of the item in the command.
entries.Translated: 要运行的命令。会自动为你添加斜杠。你可以添加 ***Name*** 来输出物品名称，或添加 ***ID*** 来在命令中输出物品名称。

entries.Original: The label to give the button.
A custom button letting you open a webpage with the item's name or ID optionally embedded into the link.
entries.Translated: 自定义按钮，可打开一个网页，链接中可选择嵌入物品名称或 ID。

entries.Original: The web link to open. You can add the ***Name*** to output the name of the item or ***ID*** to output the name of the item in the command.
entries.Translated: 要打开的网页链接。你可以添加 ***Name*** 来输出物品名称，或添加 ***ID*** 来在命令中输出物品名称。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all the items in bags related to your character. This includes owned retainers, free company, saddle bags, etc
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示与你角色相关的所有背包中的物品。包括所属雇员、部队、陆行鸟鞍囊等

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all of the game's items.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示游戏中的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show the items in your character's bags.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示你角色背包中的物品。

entries.Original: This will show all the items you have favourited.
entries.Translated: 这将显示你收藏的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all the items in your free company chest for your active character.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示你当前角色部队储物柜中的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that shows you the movement of items in your inventories. History tracking must be enabled for this to function.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个列表，显示你库存中物品的移动情况。必须启用历史记录追踪才能使用此功能。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all items stored in the houses your character owns.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示你角色拥有的房屋中存储的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show items across all retainer inventories.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示所有雇员库存中的物品。

entries.Original: The direction to sort the list in by default.
The column to use to sort by default
The time it takes between each automatic attack while engaged with and in range of an enemy in seconds.
entries.Translated: 与敌人在范围内交战时，每次自动攻击之间的间隔时间（秒）。

entries.Original: Shows where the item should be moved to or where the item was moved to in the case of a history filter.
entries.Translated: 显示物品应移动到的位置，或在历史筛选情况下显示物品已移动到的位置。

entries.Original: Define which inventories you want as destinations, the plugin will attempt try to take the items found in your 'Source Inventories' and sort them into your 'Destination Inventories'. You can see which inventories have been found based on the scope configuration below.
entries.Translated: 定义你希望作为目标的物品栏，插件将尝试获取在“源物品栏”中找到的物品并将它们分类到你的“目标物品栏”中。你可以根据下方的范围配置查看已找到哪些物品栏。

entries.Original: This lists all the destinations that are applicable given the destinations picked above.
entries.Translated: 此列表列出根据上方所选目标而适用的所有目标。

entries.Original: What class is related to de-synthesising this item?
entries.Translated: 该物品的分解与哪个职业相关？

entries.Original: Shows the difference between the iLvl of the item and your desynthesis skill and if desynthesis is optimal
entries.Translated: 显示物品品级与你的分解技能之间的差异，以及分解是否最优

entries.Original: When talking with a retainer should the filter adjust itself to only show items that should be put inside the retainer from your inventory? If set to only, highlighting will only occur when at the retainer bell and when within a retainer.
entries.Translated: 与雇员交谈时，过滤器是否应自动调整以仅显示应从你的物品栏放入该雇员的物品？如果设为仅，则仅在雇员铃处及雇员内时才会高亮。

entries.Original: This item is from outside the range visible as it's the closest item that matches, it has a lower level than the level of this column.
entries.Translated: 该物品超出可见范围，因为它是匹配度最高的物品，其等级低于此列的等级。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to clear all your stored history?
entries.Translated: 确定要清除所有已存储的历史记录吗？

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to reset your configuration to the default?
entries.Translated: 您确定要将配置重置为默认值吗？

entries.Original: Gatherable and purchasable items can be grouped by zone.
entries.Translated: 可采集和可购买物品可以按区域分组。

entries.Original: Improved handling of items that can be purchased with seals, poetics, and scrip currencies.
entries.Translated: 改进了可用军票、诗学和巧手紫票货币购买的物品的处理。

entries.Original: Retrievable items can be prioritized in their own group.
entries.Translated: 可回收物品可以在其自己的分组中优先显示。

entries.Original: The 'Next Step' column provides guidance on what you should do next.
entries.Translated: '下一步' 列提供您接下来该做什么的指引。

entries.Original: The 'Settings' column allows you to configure item sourcing, retainer settings, and recipes.
entries.Translated: '设置' 列允许您配置物品来源、雇员设置和配方。

entries.Original: The craft system has received an update, and your default configuration has been reset. Please readjust it according to your preferences.
entries.Translated: 制作系统已更新，您的默认配置已被重置。请根据您的偏好重新调整。

entries.Original: The update includes the following changes:
entries.Translated: 本次更新包含以下更改：

entries.Original: Two new columns have been added to your craft lists: 'Next Step' and 'Settings'.
entries.Translated: 您的制作列表新增了两列：'下一步' 和 '设置'。

entries.Original: You can customize these options further by clicking the pencil icon in the top right corner of a list.
entries.Translated: 您可以点击列表右上角的铅笔图标进一步自定义这些选项。

entries.Original: You can now change groupings for crafts based on class or required crafting order.
entries.Translated: 您现在可以根据职业或所需制作顺序更改制作分组。

entries.Original: You can now copy configurations between your craft lists.
entries.Translated: 您现在可以在制作列表之间复制配置。

entries.Original: Filter out any items that do not appear in both the source and destination?
entries.Translated: 过滤掉任何未同时出现在源和目标中的物品？

entries.Original: The number of dyes the item has or supports.
entries.Translated: 物品拥有的染色数量或支持的染色数量。

entries.Original: How many dyes does this item have or can it support?
entries.Translated: 该物品有多少个染色位或可支持多少个？

entries.Original: A list of all the NPCs in the game

entries.Translated: ID 为以下值的敌方 NPC

entries.Original: Is this item available at a ephemeral node?
entries.Translated: 该物品是否可在限时采集点获取？

entries.Original: Compares what you are wearing against what you could be wearing and suggests upgrades. These are the defaults the recommendation screen opens with.
entries.Translated: 将你当前穿戴的装备与可以穿戴的装备进行比较并建议升级。这些是推荐界面打开时的默认值。

entries.Original: What mode should the equipment recommendation screen show? Class lets you pick a class and get recommendations for it. Tool lets you pick out the tools for a set of classes.
entries.Translated: 装备推荐界面应显示哪种模式？职业模式可让你选择一个职业并获取其推荐。工具模式可让你为一组职业挑选工具。
添加到新制作清单（临时）

entries.Original: Should the equipment recommendation screen be compact or normal?
entries.Translated: 装备推荐界面应为紧凑还是普通？

entries.Original: Hitting this will pick the highest iLvl items while also factoring in the relevant stats for the seleted class/item.
entries.Translated: 点击此项将选取物品等级最高的装备，同时兼顾所选职业/物品的相关属性。

entries.Original: Which classes can this equipment be equipped by?
entries.Translated: 该装备可由哪些职业装备？

entries.Original: Shows if an item can be equipped by a specific gender.
entries.Translated: 显示物品是否可由特定性别装备。

entries.Original: Which genders can this equipment be equipped by?
entries.Translated: 该装备可由哪些性别装备？

entries.Original: Shows if an item can be equipped by a specific race.
entries.Translated: 显示物品是否可由特定种族装备。

entries.Original: Which races can this equipment be equipped by?
entries.Translated: 该装备可由哪些种族装备？

entries.Original: Shows what class/job an item can be equipped by
entries.Translated: 显示物品可由哪些职业装备

entries.Original: The number of seals that are rewarded when handing this item in as an expert delivery.
entries.Translated: 将该物品作为筹备稀有品提交时获得的军票数量。

entries.Original: Is this item in your list of favourites?
entries.Translated: 此物品是否在你的收藏列表中？

entries.Original: When filtering items each filter set will narrow down the list of available items using AND, instead of using AND, use OR
entries.Translated: 过滤物品时，每个过滤器集将使用 AND 缩小可用物品列表，不使用 AND，而使用 OR
在标签页中显示复选框

entries.Original: !  - results that do not contain what is entered - text and numbers.
entries.Translated: !  - 不包含所输入内容的结果 - 文本和数字。

entries.Original: && and || - AND and OR respectively, used to chain operators together.
entries.Translated: && 和 || - 分别表示 AND 和 OR，用于串联运算符。

entries.Original: <  - results with a value less than what is entered - numbers.
entries.Translated: <  - 数值小于所输入内容的结果 - 数字。

entries.Original: <= - results with a value less than or equal to what is entered - numbers.
entries.Translated: <= - 数值小于或等于所输入内容的结果 - 数字。

entries.Original: =  - results with a value exactly equal to what is entered - text and numbers.
entries.Translated: =  - 数值完全等于所输入内容的结果 - 文本和数字。

entries.Original: >  - results with a value greater than what is entered - numbers.
entries.Translated: >  - 数值大于所输入内容的结果 - 数字。

entries.Original: >= - results with a value greater than or equal to what is entered - numbers.
entries.Translated: >= - 数值大于或等于所输入内容的结果 - 数字。

entries.Original: When creating a list, or when searching through the results of a list, you can use a series of operators to make your search more specific. Which operators are available depends on what you are searching against.
entries.Translated: 创建列表或搜索列表结果时，你可以使用一系列运算符让搜索更精确。可用的运算符取决于你搜索的对象。

entries.Original: These lists show you what the plugin can do. If you select them, they'll be installed once you complete the wizard.
entries.Translated: 这些列表展示了插件的功能。如果你选择它们，完成向导后它们将被安装。
历史记录追踪当前已禁用

entries.Original: When checked, any items matching the filter will be highlighted once you search in any of the columns.
entries.Translated: 勾选后，在任意列中搜索时，匹配过滤器的物品将被高亮显示。

entries.Original: When checked, any items matching the filter will be highlighted.
entries.Translated: 勾选后，匹配过滤器的物品将被高亮显示。

entries.Original: Are you sure you want to clear this curated list?
entries.Translated: 确定要清空此精选列表吗？
导出当前列表（分享代码）

entries.Original: Please enter a valid share code for a list below and then hit ok to import it.
entries.Translated: 请在下方输入有效的列表分享代码，然后点击确定以导入。

entries.Original: You are currently editing the list's configuration. Press the tick on the right hand side to save configuration.
entries.Translated: 你正在编辑列表配置。点击右侧的对勾以保存配置。

entries.Original: This will create a list that lets you add individual items to it manually.
entries.Translated: 这将创建一个列表，让你可以手动添加单个物品。

entries.Original: Set the layout of the items window
Folklore tomes unlock hidden gathering nodes.
entries.Translated: 传承录可解锁隐藏的采集点。

entries.Original: Is this item available at a calmity salvager?
entries.Translated: 此物品是否可在失物招领人处获得？

entries.Original: Shows a button that opens the item's gathering/fishing log entry if applicable.
entries.Translated: 显示一个打开该物品采集/钓鱼笔记的按钮（如适用）。

entries.Original: Provides the gearsets that an item is part of.
Filter by the gear sets that a item is in.
Gearsets based on Eorzea Collection's organizing.
Allagan Tools is a multi-purpose plugin providing 3 primary features: tracking and displaying your inventory data, helping you plan crafts, and providing information about items.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 是一个多功能插件，提供 3 项主要功能：追踪并显示你的物品栏数据、帮助你规划制作，以及提供物品信息。

entries.Original: If you've ever used Teamcraft, you should be right at home.
entries.Translated: 如果你用过 Teamcraft，应该会非常熟悉。

entries.Original: If you've used Teamcraft or Garland Tools, it takes some inspiration from both.
entries.Translated: 如果你用过 Teamcraft 或 Garland Tools，它从两者中都借鉴了一些灵感。

entries.Original: Once the plugin knows about the items, you can create lists to narrow down searches for specific items, help you sort them, and a myriad of other things.
entries.Translated: 一旦插件识别了这些物品，你就可以创建列表来缩小特定物品的搜索范围、帮助你整理它们，以及许多其他功能。

entries.Original: The plugin has a dedicated crafts window that lets you create lists of items you want to craft. It'll create a plan that breaks each item down into its individual parts and tell you what you're missing, where everything you need is, and where to find or buy anything you don't have.
entries.Translated: 插件有一个专门的制作窗口，让你创建想要制作的物品列表。它会生成一份计划，将每件物品拆解为各个部件，并告诉你缺少什么、所需的一切在哪里，以及在哪里找到或购买你没有的东西。

entries.Original: The plugin has a fairly comprehensive database of information about each item. If you've used Garland Tools, the information provided is very similar. Clicking an item's icon within the plugin will always open the item's information window.
entries.Translated: 插件拥有一个相当全面的物品信息数据库。如果你用过 Garland Tools，提供的信息非常相似。在插件中点击物品图标总会打开该物品的信息窗口。

entries.Original: The plugin will do its best to keep track of your inventories. Some inventories are only cached when they are first accessed. If you aren't seeing your retainer, free company, glamour chest and so on, please be sure to view them first otherwise the plugin cannot cache them.
entries.Translated: 插件会尽力追踪你的物品栏。部分物品栏只有在首次访问时才会被缓存。如果你看不到你的雇员、部队、幻化柜等，请务必先查看它们，否则插件无法缓存。

entries.Original: This is a very basic guide. For more information please see the wiki.
entries.Translated: 这是一个非常基础的指南。如需更多信息，请参阅 wiki。

entries.Original: When using either an item list or a craft list, you can toggle highlighting. This will highlight the items in game so that you can see exactly where they are. When the plugin's windows are active, hit the 'Highlight' checkbox to activate highlighting for that list. To trigger this with a macro, see the commands section of help and toggle 'background' highlighting.
entries.Translated: 使用物品列表或制作列表时，你可以切换高亮。这会在游戏中高亮显示物品，让你能准确看到它们的位置。当插件的窗口处于活动状态时，勾选“高亮”复选框即可为该列表启用高亮。若要用宏触发此功能，请参阅帮助中的命令部分并切换“后台”高亮。

entries.Original: Allagan Tools keeps its own record of your inventories. These control how often that record is written to disk.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 会保留自己的库存记录。这些选项控制该记录写入磁盘的频率。

entries.Original: Ways to reach Allagan Tools from outside its own windows.
entries.Translated: 从 Allagan Tools 自身窗口之外访问它的方式。

entries.Original: Can the item be sourced via
entries.Translated: 该物品能否通过以下途径获取

entries.Original: Can the item be used for
Is the item combined in the glamour chest?
entries.Translated: 该物品是否在幻化柜中合并？

entries.Original: Has this gathering item been gathered at least once by the currently logged in character? This only supports mining and botany at present.
entries.Translated: 该采集品是否曾被当前登录角色采集过至少一次？目前仅支持采矿和园艺。

entries.Original: Is this item available at a hidden node?
entries.Translated: 此物品是否可在隐藏采集点获得？

entries.Original: The color to set the highlighted items to for this specific filter. If not overridden the global highlighting color will be used.
entries.Translated: 为此特定过滤器设置高亮物品的颜色。如果未覆盖，将使用全局高亮颜色。

entries.Original: The color to set the highlighted items to.
The color to set any items in the destination that match your source filter(assuming highlight destination duplicates is on).
entries.Translated: 设置目标中与来源筛选匹配的物品的颜色（假设已开启高亮目标重复项）。

entries.Original: When highlighting destinations should empty spots be highlighted or only items that already exist in the destination?
entries.Translated: 高亮目标位置时，是应高亮空位还是仅高亮目标位置中已存在的物品？

entries.Original: Should any items that match in the destination bag be highlighted?
entries.Translated: 是否应高亮目标背包中匹配的任何物品？

entries.Original: Should the destination for items be highlighted? This can be overridden in the filter configuration.
entries.Translated: 是否高亮物品的目标位置？可在过滤器配置中覆盖此设置。

entries.Original: When highlighting is turned on for a list, should it always be active or should it only be active when a column is being searched in
entries.Translated: 当列表开启高亮时，应始终激活还是仅在搜索某列时激活？

entries.Original: Highlighting is generally controlled by hitting the 'Highlight' button within the various windows and via slash commands, you can toggle highlight on/off here as well.
entries.Translated: 高亮通常由各窗口中的“高亮”按钮和斜杠命令控制，你也可以在此处开关高亮。

entries.Original: Highlighting tints inventory slots and bag tabs when a list matches the items inside them. These are the defaults, individual lists can override most of them.
entries.Translated: 当列表与库存槽位和背包标签中的物品匹配时，高亮会为其着色。这些是默认值，单个列表可以覆盖其中大部分设置。

entries.Original: Sort lists know where items are meant to end up. The destination bag can be highlighted alongside the source so you can see both ends of a move at once.
entries.Translated: 整理清单知道物品的最终去向。目标背包可与来源一同高亮，让你一眼看清移动的两端。

entries.Original: The summoning bell list can be annotated when a retainer holds items one of your lists cares about, so you know which to open without checking each one.
entries.Translated: 当雇员持有你某个清单关注的物品时，传唤铃清单会加以标注，让你无需逐个查看就知道该打开哪个。

entries.Original: While a vendor window is open, shop items matched by a list can be highlighted, and the vendors that sell them can be marked out in the world.
entries.Translated: 当商店窗口打开时，清单匹配的商品会高亮，出售这些商品的商人也会在世界中标记出来。

entries.Original: When did the historical inventory event happen?
entries.Translated: 库存历史事件发生于何时？

entries.Original: Should Allagan Tools attempt to track the movement, addition and removal of items in your inventories?
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 是否应尝试追踪你背包中物品的移动、添加和移除？

entries.Original: Records items moving into, out of and around your inventories so you can look back at what changed. History lists then read from that record.
entries.Translated: 记录物品进出和在你的背包间移动的情况，让你可以回头看发生了什么变化。历史清单随后从该记录中读取。

entries.Original: Without this enabled, History type lists will not function.
entries.Translated: 未启用此项时，历史类型清单将无法使用。

entries.Original: Which events should be tracked by the history module?
entries.Translated: 历史模块应追踪哪些事件？

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the lists window.
entries.Translated: 切换列表窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the airships window.
entries.Translated: 切换飞空艇窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the configuration window.
entries.Translated: 切换配置窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the craft window.
entries.Translated: 切换制作窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the duties window.
entries.Translated: 切换任务窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the mob window.
entries.Translated: 切换怪物窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to open the more information window for an item when hovering it.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时打开更多信息窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to open the crafting log for an item when hovering it.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时打开制作笔记的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to open the fishing log for an item when hovering it.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时打开钓鱼笔记的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to open the gathering log for an item when hovering it.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时打开采集笔记的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to open the relevant log entry(gathering, crafting, fishing) for an item when hovering it.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时打开相关笔记条目（采集、制作、钓鱼）的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the retainer ventures window.
entries.Translated: 切换雇员探险窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: The hotkey to toggle the submarines window.
entries.Translated: 切换潜水艇窗口的快捷键。

entries.Original: These hotkeys apply to the item under the cursor. If there is no item under the cursor, they do nothing.
entries.Translated: 这些快捷键适用于光标下的物品。如果光标下没有物品，它们不会执行任何操作。

entries.Original: These hotkeys are optional. If you leave a field empty, that action has no hotkey.
entries.Translated: 这些快捷键是可选的。如果留空，该操作就没有快捷键。

entries.Original: While the cursor is over an item
entries.Translated: 当光标悬停在物品上时

entries.Original: These act on whatever item is under the cursor, so they only do anything while an item is hovered.
entries.Translated: 这些操作作用于光标下的物品，因此仅在悬停物品时才会生效。

entries.Original: Work anywhere, whether or not you are hovering something.
entries.Translated: 随处可用，无论是否悬停在某物上。

entries.Original: Shows the icon of the item, pressing it will open the more information window for the item.
entries.Translated: 显示物品图标，点击将打开该物品的详细信息窗口。

entries.Original: When sorting should the filter consider HQ and NQ items to be the same when attempting to stack them? This primary use for this filter is to find items that can have their quality lowered.
entries.Translated: 分类时，过滤器在尝试堆叠时是否应将 HQ 和 NQ 物品视为相同？此过滤器的主要用途是查找可以降低品质的物品。

entries.Original: Should a tooltip for items be shown, never, when hovering an item's icon or when hovering any row within an item table?
entries.Translated: 是否显示物品提示：从不、悬停物品图标时或悬停物品表格任意行时？

entries.Original: Shows a number indicating the highest patch a craft material is used in.
entries.Translated: 显示一个数字，指示制作材料所使用的最高版本。

entries.Original: Select craftable items and the filter will determine the ingredients used in the craft and will only list those ingredients. The add all from filter button will add all the items from the selected filter to the list.
entries.Translated: 选择可制作物品，筛选器将确定制作中使用的材料，并仅列出这些材料。点击“从筛选添加全部”按钮会将所选筛选中的所有物品添加到列表中。
包含任务、讨伐战等在内的副本

entries.Original: Classes, gearsets, chocobo items and more besides.
entries.Translated: 职业、套装、陆行鸟物品等等。

entries.Original: Duties, leves, beast tribes and custom deliveries.
entries.Translated: 任务、理符、蛮族和老主顾交易。

entries.Original: Each entry links through to everything related to it, so you can follow a chain from an item to the duty that drops it to the NPC that sells the rest.
entries.Translated: 每个条目都会链接到与之相关的一切，因此你可以顺着链条从一件物品追踪到掉落它的任务，再到出售其余物品的 NPC。

entries.Original: It also lives under the Compendium menu in the items and crafts windows, or the /compendium command.
entries.Translated: 它也在物品和制作窗口的图鉴菜单下，或通过 /compendium 命令打开。

entries.Original: NPCs, territories, and airship and submarine routes.
entries.Translated: NPC、区域，以及飞空艇和潜水艇航线。

entries.Original: Relic weapons and tools, master recipe books, folklore tomes and soul crystals.
entries.Translated: 上古武器和工具、秘籍、传承录和灵魂水晶。

entries.Original: The compendium is a browsable reference for the game's content, built from the same data the plugin uses everywhere else. If you want to know what something is, where it comes from or what drops it, this is where to look.
entries.Translated: 图鉴是一个可浏览的游戏内容参考，由插件在其他各处使用的相同数据构建而成。如果你想知道某个东西是什么、来自哪里或由什么掉落，这里就是查找的地方。

entries.Original: A craft list takes what you want to make and breaks it into every intermediate item and raw material, then checks that against what you already own.
entries.Translated: 制作列表会把你想要制作的东西拆解为每一个中间物品和原材料，然后与你已有的物品进行比对。

entries.Original: A full material tree, not just the immediate ingredients.
entries.Translated: 完整的材料树，而不仅仅是直接材料。

entries.Original: Progress ticking down as you acquire things.
entries.Translated: 随着你获取物品，进度会逐步减少。

entries.Original: What you already have, and which character or retainer is holding it.
entries.Translated: 你已拥有的物品，以及由哪个角色或雇员持有。

entries.Original: Where to buy or gather whatever is missing.
entries.Translated: 在哪里购买或采集缺少的物品。

entries.Original: By default, the plugin is configured with a default set of features enabled.
entries.Translated: 默认情况下，插件已启用一组默认功能。

entries.Original: Hover the ? icons to get further information about what each setting does.
entries.Translated: 将鼠标悬停在 ? 图标上可获取每项设置的更多信息。

entries.Original: The next screens will show you the settings for the most commonly used features.
entries.Translated: 接下来的界面将向你展示最常用功能的设置。

entries.Original: Free company chest: open every tab you care about.
entries.Translated: 部队储物柜：打开你关心的每个标签页。

entries.Original: Open it in game once and it will be remembered from then on. Most commonly:
entries.Translated: 在游戏中打开一次，之后就会被记住。最常见的有：

entries.Original: Retainers: talk to a summoning bell and open each retainer's inventory.
entries.Translated: 雇员：与传唤铃对话并打开每个雇员的物品栏。

entries.Original: The plugin can only see an inventory after the game has shown it to you at least once. That is a limit of how the game sends its data, not a setting you can turn on.
entries.Translated: 插件只有在游戏至少向你展示过一次物品栏后才能看到它。这是游戏发送数据的限制，不是你可以开启的设置。

entries.Original: The plugin keeps its own copy, so you can search your retainers' contents from anywhere without going back to a bell.
entries.Translated: 插件会保留自己的副本，因此你可以在任何地方搜索雇员的内容，而无需回到传唤铃。

entries.Original: Almost everything in the plugin hangs off a list. A list is a saved search over your items, and once you have one you can highlight its results in game, sort them, or track them.

entries.Original: Sort list: find items and work out where they should be moved to.

entries.Original: The items window is where lists live. There are sample lists you can install as well.

entries.Original: Allagan Tools does three main things. The next few pages cover each briefly. It should take a minute, and all of it is in the Help window later if you want more detail.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 主要有三大功能。接下来几页将分别简要介绍。应该只需一分钟，如果你想了解更多细节，之后都可以在帮助窗口中查看。

entries.Original: Filter by the categories available on the market board.
entries.Translated: 按市场布告板可用的分类筛选。

entries.Original: Master recipe books unlock additional crafting recipes.
entries.Translated: 秘籍可解锁额外的制作配方。

entries.Original: The amount this item can be sold to a vendor for(gil).
entries.Translated: 该物品可出售给商人的价格（金币）。

entries.Original: The total amount this item can be sold to a vendor for in gil(price * quantity).
entries.Translated: 该物品出售给商人的总金额（金币）（价格 * 数量）。

entries.Original: Items that share the same model.
When highlighting items in a shop, should the not highlighted items be disabled?
entries.Translated: 高亮商店中的物品时，是否应禁用未高亮的物品？

entries.Original: The color used to highlight NPCs in the world when shop items are highlighted.
entries.Translated: 高亮商店物品时，用于高亮世界中 NPC 的颜色。

entries.Original: When highlighting shop items, show a small vendor icon on the nameplate of related NPCs in the world.
entries.Translated: 高亮商店物品时，在世界中相关 NPC 的名牌上显示一个小商人图标。

entries.Original: When highlighting items in a shop, should related NPCs be highlighted in the world?
entries.Translated: 高亮商店中的物品时，是否应在世界中高亮相关 NPC？

entries.Original: Provides a series of small buttons that allow opening garland tools and trying on items.
entries.Translated: 提供一系列小按钮，可打开 garland tools 并试穿物品。

entries.Original: Should the main window show the tab called 'All Lists' containing all available lists in one tab?
entries.Translated: 主窗口是否显示名为“所有列表”的标签页，在一个标签页中包含所有可用列表？

entries.Original: Should the name of the retainer in the summoning bell list have the number of items to be sorted or are available in their inventory?
entries.Translated: 传唤铃列表中雇员的名字是否显示其背包中待整理或可用物品的数量？

entries.Original: Disable/enable the entire tooltip modification system for the plugin. If this is off, no changes will be made to your item's tooltips.
entries.Translated: 禁用/启用插件的整个提示修改系统。若关闭，将不会对物品提示做任何更改。

entries.Original: Which source categories should this display?
Shows the character/retainer an item is located in.
entries.Translated: 显示物品所在的角色/雇员。

entries.Original: When source acquisition icons are displayed, how should they be grouped?
entries.Translated: 显示来源获取图标时，应如何分组？

entries.Original: This is a list of source inventories to sort items from based on the filter configuration
entries.Translated: 这是根据筛选配置对物品进行排序的来源背包列表

entries.Original: Define the scope of inventories you want to see in the historical list of inventory changes.
entries.Translated: 定义你想在库存变更历史列表中查看的库存范围。

entries.Original: Define which inventories you want to be searched, the plugin will then attempt to show you where to put them in the destinations you have selected. You can see which inventories have been found based on the scope configuration below.
entries.Translated: 定义要搜索的库存，插件将尝试向你显示在所选目标位置中放置它们的位置。你可以根据下方的范围配置查看已找到的库存。

entries.Original: Define which inventories you want to be searched, these will show up in the list. You can see which inventories have been found based on the scope configuration below.
entries.Translated: 定义要搜索的库存，这些将显示在列表中。你可以根据下方的范围配置查看已找到的库存。

entries.Original: Which source types should this display?
The world where the item is stored(be it in a character, retainer, free company)
entries.Translated: 物品存放的服务器（无论是在角色、雇员还是部队中）

entries.Original: This lists all the sources that are applicable given the sources picked above.
entries.Translated: 此处列出根据上方所选来源筛选出的所有适用来源。

entries.Original: The spirit bond of the item.
Shows the spiritbond % of the item.
entries.Translated: 显示物品的精炼度百分比。

entries.Original: The maximum stack size of the item.
The current dye of the item
Choose the display mode of the dye column
entries.Translated: 选择染色列的显示模式

entries.Original: Is this item sold in the square store?
entries.Translated: 该物品是否在商城出售？
部队潜水艇航行的路线

entries.Original: Only press this if you have been instructed to, it will generate a zip file containing your inventory, the allagan tools configuration, and your logs. If you are attempting to provide this information to help fix a bug, turn on Verbose Logging in File, replicate the bug and then generate this dump. Proceed?
entries.Translated: 仅在收到指示时才按下此按钮，它会生成一个 zip 文件，包含你的物品栏、Allagan Tools 配置和日志。如果你是为了帮助修复 bug 而提供此信息，请在“文件”中开启详细日志，复现该 bug，然后生成此转储。是否继续？

entries.Original: Should the active craft list automatically change when moving between each craft list? The active craft list will only change if there is an active craft list already selected.
entries.Translated: 在各个制作列表之间切换时，是否自动更改当前制作列表？仅当已选择当前制作列表时才会更改。

entries.Original: When you view a different list, should highlighting automatically switch to the list you are viewing? Highlighting will only change to the new list if highlighting is already active.
entries.Translated: 当你查看其他列表时，高亮是否自动切换到正在查看的列表？仅当高亮已激活时才会切换到新列表。

entries.Original: The color to set the highlighted tabs(which contain filtered items) to for this specific filter. If not overridden the tab highlighting color will be used.
entries.Translated: 为特定筛选器设置高亮标签页（包含已筛选物品）的颜色。若未覆盖，将使用标签页高亮颜色。

entries.Original: The color to set the highlighted tabs(that contain filtered items) to.
entries.Translated: 设置高亮标签页（包含筛选物品）的颜色。

entries.Original: The number of columns starting at 1 to freeze(always display when scrolling).
entries.Translated: 从1开始冻结的列数（滚动时始终显示）。

entries.Original: How many pixels high should each item row try to display at?
entries.Translated: 每个物品行尝试显示的高度为多少像素？

entries.Original:
Guide to importing lists.

Step 1. Open a list on Teamcraft with the items you wish to craft.

Step 2. Find the 'Items' "Copy as Text" button. You only want to copy the output items.

Step 3. Paste into the text box below in this window.

Step 4. Click import.
entries.Translated:
导入清单指南。

第 1 步：在 Teamcraft 上打开包含你想制作物品的清单。

第 2 步：找到“物品”的“复制为文本”按钮。你只需复制输出的物品。

第 3 步：粘贴到此窗口下方的文本框中。

第 4 步：点击导入。
游戏开始中可用的区域

entries.Original: Is this item available at a timed node?
entries.Translated: 该物品是否可在限时采集点获得？

entries.Original: The maximum amount of locations to list on the tooltip. This requires 'Display Amount Owned?' to be enabled.
entries.Translated: 悬浮提示中列出的最大位置数量。这需要启用"显示拥有数量？"。

entries.Original: When hovering an item and you have an amount owned by a retainer, should the owner of that retainer be affixed to that item?
entries.Translated: 悬停物品且你有雇员持有该物品时，是否在该物品上紧抱显示该雇员所属角色名？

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Add Item Locations' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用时，“添加物品位置”提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: How should the items displayed in the tooltip that you own be ordered? None is included if you find the sorting to be non-performant.
entries.Translated: 悬浮提示中显示的已拥有物品应如何排序？如果排序影响性能，可选择"无"。

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Amount to Retrieve' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用时，“取出数量”提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: When hovering an item, should the tooltip contain the average market price for both NQ and HQ. Please make sure 'Automatically download prices' is enabled.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时，提示是否包含 NQ 和 HQ 的平均市场价格。请确保已启用“自动下载价格”。

entries.Original: Makes the Tooltip Category Whitelist into a Blacklist if checked.
entries.Translated: 勾选后将悬浮提示分类白名单变为黑名单。

entries.Original: When adding information to tooltips, should we limit the items affected to these categories? If 'Tooltip Category Blacklist` is checked, this functionality will be reversed.
entries.Translated: 向悬浮提示添加信息时，是否应将受影响的物品限制为这些分类？如果勾选了"悬浮提示分类黑名单"，此功能将反转。

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Coffer Loot' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用后，"宝箱战利品"悬浮提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: Which inventories should be searched when determining how many coffer loot items you already own?
entries.Translated: 在确定你已拥有多少宝箱战利品时，应搜索哪些物品栏？

entries.Original: This is the colour of any text added to the item tooltip. You can give each tooltip module it's own colour by going into the tooltip's settings.
entries.Translated: 这是添加到物品悬浮提示的所有文本的颜色。你可以进入各悬浮提示模块的设置为其单独设置颜色。

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Curated List' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用时，“精选列表”提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: Should the quality of the hovered item match the quality stored in the curated list? When off, a NQ item will match a HQ entry and vice versa.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品的品质是否应与收藏列表中存储的品质匹配？关闭时，NQ 物品将匹配 HQ 条目，反之亦然。

entries.Original: Which curated lists should be checked? If no lists are picked, every curated list is checked.
entries.Translated: 应检查哪些收藏列表？如果未选择任何列表，则检查所有收藏列表。

entries.Original: Limits the information displayed on the tooltip to inventories belonging to the currently logged in character.
entries.Translated: 将提示中显示的信息限制为属于当前登录角色的背包。

entries.Original: When hovering an item, should the tooltip show the locations of any copies of the item you currently own?
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时，悬浮提示是否应显示你当前拥有的该物品副本的位置？

entries.Original: When hovering a coffer, card pack, or loot container, show how many of its possible loot items you already own.
entries.Translated: 悬停宝箱、卡包或战利品容器时，显示其中可能的战利品中你已拥有多少。

entries.Original: When hovering an item, show which of your curated lists already contain it.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时，显示你的哪些收藏列表已包含该物品。

entries.Original: When hovering an item, show whether it is a Outfit Glamour Set or part of one, along with which component items you already have in your Armory Chest or Armoire.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时，显示它是套装幻化还是套装的一部分，以及你的兵装库或衣柜中已拥有哪些部件。

entries.Original: Should [Allagan Tools] be displayed in the tooltip above any tooltip modifications?
entries.Translated: [Allagan Tools] 是否应显示在悬浮提示中所有悬浮提示修改内容的上方？

entries.Original: Displays the last patch an ingredient was used in. This is calculated by going each recipe an item is part of, then through it's recipes and so on until the highest patch is determined.
entries.Translated: 显示材料最后一次被使用的版本。计算方式为遍历物品所属的每个配方，再遍历其配方，依此类推，直到确定最高版本。

entries.Original: Should the amount required to be retrieved be shown in the tooltip?
entries.Translated: 是否在悬浮提示中显示需要取回的数量？

entries.Original: When showing the unlock status on items, these characters will be displayed. Leave empty to display all characters.
entries.Translated: 显示物品解锁状态时，将显示这些角色。留空则显示所有角色。

entries.Original: How should the item unlock status tooltip be displayed?
entries.Translated: 物品解锁状态悬浮提示应如何显示？

entries.Original: Should characters that already have this unlocked be hidden? If in grouped mode, this will hide the acquired group.
entries.Translated: 是否隐藏已解锁的角色？若为分组模式，将隐藏已获取的分组。

entries.Original: If an item can be unlocked/acquired, shows if your characters have unlocked/acquired said item. Can be configured to show specific characters inside the configuration window.
entries.Translated: 如果物品可以解锁/获得，则显示你的角色是否已解锁/获得该物品。可在配置窗口中配置显示特定角色。

entries.Original: How many new lines should be added below any tooltip modifications made by this plugin?
entries.Translated: 在此插件修改的悬浮提示下方添加多少空行？

entries.Original: In detailed mode, what colour should acquired items be shown in?
entries.Translated: 在详细模式下，已获得物品应以什么颜色显示？

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Outfit Glamour' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用后，"套装幻化"悬浮提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: How the Glamour Ready Set information should be displayed in the tooltip. Detailed lists each piece with its ownership status; Compact shows a summary count.
entries.Translated: 幻化套装信息在悬浮提示中的显示方式。详细会列出每件装备及其拥有状态；紧凑则显示汇总数量。

entries.Original: In detailed mode, what colour should not-yet-acquired items be shown in?
entries.Translated: 在详细模式下，尚未获得的物品应以什么颜色显示？

entries.Original: Which inventories should be searched when determining which outfit glamour set items you already own?
entries.Translated: 在确定你已拥有哪些套装幻化物品时，应搜索哪些物品栏？

entries.Original: How many new lines should be added above any tooltip modifications made by this plugin?
entries.Translated: 在此插件修改的悬浮提示上方添加多少空行？

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Ingredient Patch' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用后，"材料补丁"悬浮提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Item Unlock Status' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用时，“物品解锁状态”提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: How the locations of items should be presented in the tooltip. This requires 'Add Item Locations?' to be on.
entries.Translated: 物品位置在悬浮提示中的呈现方式。这需要开启"添加物品位置？"。

entries.Original: When showing the locations of the items you own in the tooltip, which inventories should be included in the search?
entries.Translated: 在悬浮提示中显示你拥有的物品位置时，搜索应包含哪些物品栏？

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Market Pricing' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用时，“市场价格”提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: When hovering an item, should the tooltip contain the minimum market price for both NQ and HQ. Please make sure 'Automatically download prices' is enabled.
entries.Translated: 悬停物品时，悬浮提示是否应包含 NQ 和 HQ 的最低市场价格。请确保已启用"自动下载价格"。

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Source Information' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用后，"来源信息"悬浮提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: Should source information be shown in the tooltip? For example that an item can be sourced via crafting, shops, monsters etc
entries.Translated: 悬浮提示中是否应显示来源信息？例如物品可通过制作、商店、怪物等获得

entries.Original: Should the tooltip only be shown if a modifier key is pressed?
entries.Translated: 是否仅在按下修饰键时才显示悬浮提示？

entries.Original: If the source information tooltip is enabled, how should the various sources be ordered/displayed/etc?
entries.Translated: 若启用来源信息悬浮提示，各种来源应如何排序/显示等？

entries.Original: When enabled, what colour should the text be for the 'Use Information' tooltip text be?
entries.Translated: 启用后，"用途信息"悬浮提示文本应使用什么颜色？

entries.Original: Should use information be shown in the tooltip? For example, the item is used in a recipe or as currency at a shop, etc
entries.Translated: 悬浮提示中是否应显示用途信息？例如物品用于配方或作为商店货币等

entries.Original: If the use information tooltip is enabled, how should the various uses be ordered/displayed/etc?
entries.Translated: 若启用用途信息悬浮提示，各种用途应如何排序/显示等？

entries.Original: Allagan Tools can add extra lines to the game's item tooltips.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 可以为游戏的物品提示信息添加额外行。

entries.Original: Each line has more options in the settings window, under Tooltips. The options include colours, the locations to search, and the display mode.
entries.Translated: 每一行在设置窗口的“提示信息”下都有更多选项。选项包括颜色、搜索位置和显示模式。

entries.Original: Allagan Tools can add extra lines to the game's item tooltips. Every feature in this section is inactive unless tooltip tweaks are enabled.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 可以为游戏物品提示框添加额外行。除非启用提示框调整，否则本节所有功能均不生效。

entries.Original: Defaults for the lines Allagan Tools adds. Each feature can override the colour.
entries.Translated: Allagan Tools 添加行的默认值。每个功能都可覆盖颜色。

entries.Original: For coffers and containers, what they can contain.
entries.Translated: 对于宝箱和容器，显示其可能包含的内容。

entries.Original: How many of this item your active list(sort list or craft list) still wants you to retrieve.
entries.Translated: 你的活动清单（整理清单或制作清单）还需要你取回多少该物品。

entries.Original: How the item can be acquired.
Universalis pricing for the item. Either line can be shown on its own.
entries.Translated: 该物品的 Universalis 价格。任一行都可单独显示。

entries.Original: What the item can be turned into or spent on.
entries.Translated: 物品可制作成或用于兑换的内容。

entries.Original: Where you already own this item, and how many.
entries.Translated: 你已拥有该物品的位置及数量。

entries.Original: Whether the item has been learned, and by whom.
entries.Translated: 该物品是否已学会，以及由谁学会。

entries.Original: Whether this item completes an outfit you are collecting.
entries.Translated: 该物品是否补全你正在收集的套装。

entries.Original: Which of your curated lists already contain this item.
entries.Translated: 你的哪些精选清单已包含该物品。

entries.Original: Which patch a crafting ingredient was introduced in.
entries.Translated: 制作材料首次加入的版本。

entries.Original: The acquisition tracker watches what you craft, gather and loot so craft lists can tick themselves off. Both values are in seconds, and raising them trades responsiveness for reliability on a slow connection or a busy machine.
entries.Translated: 获取追踪器会监视你的制作、采集和拾取，以便制作清单自动勾选。两个数值均以秒为单位，调高它们会在慢速连接或繁忙机器上以响应速度换取可靠性。

entries.Original: Timings that only need changing if you are seeing a specific symptom. The defaults suit almost everyone.
entries.Translated: 仅在遇到特定症状时才需要调整的计时。默认值适合绝大多数人。

entries.Original: Shows how long an item will be available to gather if it's already spawned, and when the next time an item will be available to gather
entries.Translated: 显示物品当前可采集的剩余时间，以及下次可采集的时间

entries.Original: When use acquisition icons are displayed, how should they be grouped?
entries.Translated: 显示用途获取图标时，应如何分组？

entries.Original: Shows icons indicating what the items drop/can be used for
entries.Translated: 显示图标以指示物品的掉落来源/用途

entries.Original: Which use types should this display?
The type of ventures that the item can be acquired from
entries.Translated: 可获得该物品的探索类型

entries.Original: This is the list that will be highlighted when any of the allagan tools windows are visible.
entries.Translated: 当任何 Allagan Tools 窗口可见时，将高亮此列表。

entries.Original: Should the escape key be ignored for the
entries.Translated: 是否忽略 Esc 键用于

entries.Original: Control how various windows are laid out.
entries.Translated: 控制各种窗口的布局方式。

entries.Original: When switching between lists in the UI, if highlighting is on should we automatically switch highlighting to that list?
entries.Translated: 在界面中切换列表时，如果高亮已开启，是否应自动将高亮切换到该列表？

entries.Original: Windows that should stay open when you press escape.
entries.Translated: 按下 Esc 时应保持打开的窗口。

entries.Original: When grouping items by zone, which zones should take preference?
entries.Translated: 按区域分组物品时，应优先考虑哪些区域？
